searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-06-23

tweet_pool.author: karpathy
tweet_pool.text: Andrej Karpathy described a third major redesign of LLM UI/UX, in which Claude becomes a self-contained, persistent, asynchronous entity with org-wide tools and context working alongside human teams, following the website paradigm and the downloaded-app paradigm.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: High-signal practitioner framing from an OpenAI co-founder, tied to the live Slack Claude Tag launch. 2.1M views.

tweet_pool.author: SlackHQ
tweet_pool.text: Slack launched Claude Tag, letting users tag the Claude AI assistant in any channel so it reads the thread, performs the task and posts the result back where everyone can see it.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete product launch: Claude integrated natively into Slack channels as a taggable agent.

tweet_pool.author: synthwavedd
tweet_pool.text: A widely shared scoop reported that GPT-5.6 has been delayed to a mid-July target, that DeepMind's 3.5 Pro will no longer launch this month, that OpenAI's new voice model Bidi could appear in ChatGPT within the week, and that Claude Sonnet 5 is available to select enterprise customers under an Early Access Program as a stop-gap while Mythos and Fable 5 progress has stalled.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Widely circulated release-schedule scoop covering multiple frontier-lab model timelines. 1.2M views.

tweet_pool.author: OpenAI
tweet_pool.text: OpenAI opened applications for DevDay 2026, set for September 29 in San Francisco, with an application deadline of July 10 and a livestreamed opening keynote.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: First-party OpenAI announcement of DevDay 2026 date and applications.

tweet_pool.author: NVIDIAHealth
tweet_pool.text: NVIDIA launched the BioNeMo Agent Toolkit, an open, agent-ready toolkit that gives any AI agent callable tools for protein structure prediction, molecular docking and generative chemistry.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: First-party NVIDIA release of an open agent toolkit for scientific workflows.

tweet_pool.author: IntCyberDigest
tweet_pool.text: Meta halted its employee-tracking program for AI training after an internal exposure left the collected data accessible across the company, including keystrokes, screen contents, full AI prompts, transcripts and private conversations.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Company/policy move: Meta halts an employee-monitoring AI training program after a data-exposure incident.

tweet_pool.author: IntCyberDigest
tweet_pool.text: Security startup Tolmo published a transcript-level account of Claude Fable 5 writing a booting, NT-shaped kernel in Rust from an empty repo in 38 minutes, with later Claude Opus work growing it to run real Windows binaries.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete technical capability demonstration with a published transcript.

tweet_pool.author: ihtesham2005
tweet_pool.text: A post relaying remarks from Google DeepMind chief Demis Hassabis said he confirmed every frontier AI lab is working on recursive self-improvement and, in the same statement, said the safety risk of removing humans from the loop entirely keeps him up at night.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Notable leadership remark from the Google DeepMind CEO on recursive self-improvement and safety. 61K views.

tweet_pool.author: 0xMovez
tweet_pool.text: A post described a 19-page document from a senior Google engineer on Loop Engineering for LLM and agentic systems, structured as Act, Observe, Learn, Repeat, in which the model proposes a code transformation, a compiler runs it and reports back, and the loop iterates.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Useful technical analysis of an agentic compiler-optimisation loop. 243K views.

tweet_pool.author: samhogan
tweet_pool.text: A developer reported switching back to Cursor after six months on Codex, saying the agent is on par with Claude Code and Codex, that the in-app browser and design mode are the best front-end development experience, and that inline pull-request review is strong.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner comparison of coding agents from hands-on use.

tweet_pool.author: regent0x_
tweet_pool.text: A post described a setup of four Mac minis linked by free software into one machine running 235B-parameter models that no single computer could load, with regulated clients reportedly paying $3,500 a month each to use it.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Practitioner story on clustered consumer hardware running large local models commercially. 302K views.

tweet_pool.author: heynavtoor
tweet_pool.text: A post recounted that Adelphi University ran a hand-written essay by an autistic student, Moira Olmsted, through Turnitin's AI detector in February 2026, that the detector flagged it as 100% AI-generated, and that she was disciplined.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete AI-detection failure case with named institution and student. Strong engagement.

tweet_pool.author: karpathy
tweet_pool.text: Karpathy followup clarifying the Slack Claude integration is enterprise-grade.

tweet_pool.author: Ivywen_W
tweet_pool.text: Open-source AI discussed at UN Open Source Week 2026.

tweet_pool.author: HealthcareAIGuy
tweet_pool.text: Demis on AI cutting drug-discovery timelines.
